Subject: Redwood prepay — annual commitment & initial tranche timing

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move forward with an annual committed spend and would like to align on how the initial tranche and subsequent drawdowns will be invoiced. Key asks from our side:

- A clear monthly/quarterly invoice cadence tied to milestone unlocks (we have internal approval gates per country office).
- VAT handling: we need the invoice lines to show the entity and VAT treatment per EU country.
- PO and remit instructions so billing can kick off once the contract is countersigned.

Could you share a one-page cadence and the first invoice sample (company, VAT id, bank details)? I can then route to procurement.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Armand
Head of Procurement, Brightlane Health

Hi Sophie — great to hear. Putting initial materials below and looping finance/ops so we get everything right for EU VAT.

Summary (short):
- Annual committed spend: EUR 1.2M (DL-7782).
- Initial tranche (50%): invoice upon countersign; funds go into our escrow-managed ledger for client drawdowns.
- Remaining commitment: captured as monthly drawdown windows (see attached csv).
- Invoices: we can issue entity-level invoices (Redwood Ltd. — UK VAT) or Redwood GmbH (DE) depending on your legal remit. Please confirm which Brightlane entity will be billed.

Attachments: 2028-04-15_brightlane_prepay_schedule.csv (invoice cadence + drawdown windows), Brightlane_DocuSign_Commitment_v1.pdf (DocuSign packet).

Next steps we need from Brightlane:
1) Confirm billing entity + VAT ID to appear on invoices.
2) PO number for initial tranche.
3) Bank remit and contact for ACH/SEPA.

Kimberly — can you own the invoice samples and VAT routing? Lauren — please prepare the drawdown ledger template we discussed last month (CSV + human-readable ledger summary).

Ben

Hi all — assigning ownership here and clarifying VAT flow.

Sophie — quick Q: does Brightlane prefer net or gross invoicing for internal AP? We can emit invoices with VAT lines per country (we'll need the VAT registration number for each Brightlane legal entity to do so). For the EU region the options are:

- Redwood Ltd. (UK) invoice + reverse charge (if Brightlane is VAT-registered and provides ID).
- Redwood GmbH (DE) invoice with local VAT where applicable.

Please attach the VAT IDs and a sample PO number when you have them.

On the drawdown ledger: Lauren has prepared a rolling CSV where each withdrawal reduces the remaining commitment and stamps a country-code + VAT treatment column. This spreadsheet will be the source-of-truth for monthly reconciliation. I'll attach a sample invoice (DE and UK variants) once you confirm billing entity.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Billing & Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
